{{Quote|Those who wish to rid themselves of fleegs must clean the hair of their neighbors.|Askajian saying|<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />}}
'''Askajians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Askaji/Legends|Askaj]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:YarnadalGargan-PM.png|thumb|left|180px|An Askajian female.]]
Externally, Askajians appeared very similar to [[Human/Legends|humans]], mainly differing in the thick, wrinkled skin on their foreheads, their six [[Breast/Legends|breasts]], and their girth. Internally, the [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] species was adapted to desert survival with large epidermal sacs for water storage. This allowed them to go for several weeks without water. An Askajian could shed up to sixty percent of the water in his or her body with no effect other than tremendous slimming.<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> Askajians like [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]] were normally slender, and imbibing huge volumes of water increased their girth considerably.<ref name="SWCE" /> Askajians also had two hearts.<ref name="Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
Askajians lived in a primitive, tribal society, living mostly by gathering plants and hunting herds of large, woolly beasts called [[tomuon]]s.<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> Askajians used their meat, milk, fat, wool, hooves, and bones for fabric, food, shelter, and other essential items.

One of the most important figures in an Askajian tribe was the weaver, who knew the secret techniques to create tomoun cloth. Tomoun cloth was a strong, yet soft and wrinkle-resistant fabric that was a high-demand luxury item as far away as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was rumored that even [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] robes were made of tomuon wool. As this was the only export the Askajians had, their tribes had been known to fight wars over the services of especially skilled weavers.<ref name="Alien Encounters" />

The main political organizations among the Askajians were nomadic tribes composed of several extended families. These tribes were led by male or female hereditary [[Chief/Legends|chieftains]], depending on the region. Many tribes formed loose military alliances with one another in order to make war on other tribal federations.<ref name="Alien Encounters" />

===Culture===
Dancers were also important in Askajian culture. A skilled dancer acted as a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] and loremaster, re-enacting tribal history and legend and leading worship of their main goddess, the [[Moon Lady]], which was the moon of Askaj.<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> The shamans of the Moon Lady taught that joy could be found in just about everything, and that tragedy was the best time for mirth. They encouraged folk to laugh even as they die.<ref name="CC">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

In the [[Askajian language]], "Yarna" meant "pretty".<ref name="SWCE" /> An early version of this language was known as [[ancient Askajian]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" /> The ''[[Song of the Dongtha Slayer]]'' was a musical piece in ancient Askajian, containing a whopping 722 known verses.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />

Askajian [[youngling]]s were called "cubs" or "cublings".<ref name="SWCE" />

==History==
Before [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Drev Hassin]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Askajian, left his world and joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He became a [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] and fought in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="CC" />

An Askajian known as [[Rej Taunt]], the eldest son of tomuon cloth traders, became a crime boss on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He worked with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon novel">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet Askaj was under the administration of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilkadon]], whose oppression provoked many Askajians to relocate to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />

Sometime after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet was liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

During the early years of the New Republic, several Askajian tribes migrated to Tatooine with the assistance of an Imperial defector, [[Gwend]]. They brought with them tomoun cloth to trade for the technology needed to survive on the planet.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a tribe of Askajians led by [[Borno]] helped [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and three [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] companions evade capture by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost" />

==Notable Askajians==
One of the most famous Askajians in galactic history was [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]], who was one of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] favorite dancers in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Palace]] on Tatooine. When she had stored as much water as she could hold, Yarna was said to remind Jabba of his [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|"mother"]].<ref name="Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale" /> She performed the [[Dance of the Seventy Violet Veils]] at the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Afterward, she found fame as a model for jeweled [[Clothing/Legends|brassieres]].<ref name="WBO">{{StoryCite|story=Epilogue: Whatever Became Of...?|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Dean (Vigo)|Dean]] is illustrated to look like an Askajian in [[Darth Maul (2000) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 2]], but ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' identifies her as human.
